caption: The drawing is a detailed pencil illustration of a teapot positioned in profile view, oriented such that the long, pointed spout extends to the left and a curved handle is placed to the right. The body of the teapot is cylindrical with a slightly flared base and a fitted domed lid topped with a knob-like finial. The teapot is decorated on its front side with an ornate wreath or garland motif, encircling an elaborate, cursive capital letter "A" monogram. There are three inset details in the drawing: the top left corner displays a circular wreath enclosing the intertwined letters "EWD" in decorative script; the bottom left inset shows a top-down view of the teapot; and the bottom right inset provides a dimensional side diagram of the teapot with measurements marked as "4 1/4" for the height and "9 1/4" for the length, along with a sketched outline of the form. The artist’s name, "Hester Duany," is handwritten near the bottom center. The image is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray, with all elements shaded to suggest dimensionality and metallic surface. The drawing is framed within a double rectangular border.
title: Silver Teapot
